description: Fortran language support powered by zfls, a fast native re-implementation of fortls; a replacement for the Modern Fortran extension
configuration.title: zfls
config.zfls.path.markdownDescription: Path to a `zfls` executable. Empty: the one bundled with this extension, or else `zfls` on the `PATH` (for example from `conda install -c conda-forge zfls`).
config.zfls.signatureHelp.markdownDescri: Show signature help while typing procedure arguments, instead of argument snippets in completions (`--use_signature_help`).
config.zfls.codeActions.markdownDescript: Offer code actions, such as implementing deferred type-bound procedures (`--enable_code_actions`).
config.zfls.hoverSignature.markdownDescr: Show the signature of procedures in hover (`--hover_signature`).
config.zfls.preferImplementation.markdow: Hover and go to definition use the implementation of a procedure declared in an interface, such as a separate module procedure's body in a submodule, instead of the interface (`--prefer_implementation`). Go to Implementation reaches the body either way.
config.zfls.lowercaseHover.markdownDescr: Show the keywords of hover in lowercase, `real, intent(in) :: x` instead of `REAL, INTENT(IN) :: x` (`--lowercase_hover`).
config.zfls.lowercaseIntrinsics.markdown: Complete intrinsics and keywords in lowercase (`--lowercase_intrinsics`).
config.zfls.autocompleteNameOnly.markdow: Complete only procedure names, without their arguments (`--autocomplete_name_only`).
config.zfls.autocompleteNoSnippets.markd: Do not use snippets with placeholders in completions (`--autocomplete_no_snippets`).
config.zfls.autocompleteNoAutoUse.markdo: Do not offer the public names of modules that are not used yet; by default completing one adds its `use module, only: name` statement (`--autocomplete_no_auto_use`).
config.zfls.sortKeywords.markdownDescrip: Show variable keywords and procedure definitions sorted (`--sort_keywords`).
config.zfls.symbolSkipMembers.markdownDe: Leave type members out of document symbols (`--symbol_skip_mem`).
config.zfls.workspaceDiagnostics.markdow: Show the problems of every Fortran file of the workspace in the Problems panel, not only of the open ones (`--workspace_diagnostics`).
config.zfls.diagnosticSeverity.markdownD: Severity of zfls's diagnostics by code, `off` to hide them (`--diagnostic_severity`), e.g. `{"masks-parent": "off"}`. The code of a diagnostic shows in the Problems panel. In the code, a comment `! zfls: disable=masks-parent` hides a code on its line (`! zfls: disable` every code), `! zfls: disable-next-line=...` on the next line, and `! zfls: disable-file=...` in the file.
config.zfls.externalModules.markdownDesc: Modules that are not in the project, such as those of MPI or PETSc, that `USE` statements may name without a "not found" diagnostic (`--external_modules`); glob patterns, case-insensitive, e.g. `["mpi", "petsc*"]`.
config.zfls.notifyInit.markdownDescripti: Show a notification when the workspace has been indexed (`--notify_init`).
config.zfls.nthreads.markdownDescription: Threads used to index the workspace (`--nthreads`; zfls's default is 4).
config.zfls.maxLineLength.markdownDescri: Warn about code lines longer than this (`--max_line_length`; -1: off).
config.zfls.maxCommentLineLength.markdow: Warn about comment lines longer than this (`--max_comment_line_length`; -1: off).
config.zfls.fixedFormLineLength.markdown: Columns of code in a fixed-form line, as gfortran's `-ffixed-line-length-n` (72, 80 or 132): the rest is highlighted as a comment and is not read for names; `-1` for no limit (`--fixed_line_length`). Shown through semantic highlighting.
config.zfls.fixedFormCommentCharacter.ma: The character that **Toggle Line Comment** (`Ctrl+/`) puts in column 1 of a fixed-form line: `C`, `c` or `*` as in FORTRAN 77, or `!` for VS Code's own `!` at the indentation.
config.zfls.configFile.markdownDescripti: Configuration file to read instead of `.fortlsrc`, `.fortls.json` or `.fortls` (`--config`). `${workspaceFolder}`, `${env:NAME}` and `~` are expanded.
config.zfls.sourceDirs.markdownDescripti: Folders with source files, relative to the workspace folder or absolute; globs allowed (`--source_dirs`; default: the whole workspace folder). `${workspaceFolder}`, `${env:NAME}` and `~` are expanded.
config.zfls.includeDirs.markdownDescript: Folders searched for `#include` and `INCLUDE` files (`--include_dirs`). `${workspaceFolder}`, `${env:NAME}` and `~` are expanded.
config.zfls.compileCommands.markdownDesc: The `compile_commands.json` (or the folder that holds it) whose Fortran entries add include folders (`-I`) and preprocessor definitions (`-D`), e.g. `${workspaceFolder}/build-debug` (`--compile_commands`). Empty: one in the workspace folder or its `build` folder, if any. An `fpm.toml` in the workspace folder adds its include folder and preprocessor macros too.
config.zfls.excludePaths.markdownDescrip: Folders not to index (`--excl_paths`). `${workspaceFolder}`, `${env:NAME}` and `~` are expanded.
config.zfls.commentMarkers.markdownDescr: Further markers that start a comment as `!` does, outside strings, such as `;*` of a dialect that a preprocessor turns into Fortran (`--comment_markers`). zfls reads what follows as a comment, and the editor highlights it as one after a window reload (the extension writes its grammar from this setting).
config.zfls.includeSuffixes.markdownDesc: More file extensions to index as Fortran, e.g. `.inc` (`--incl_suffixes`).
config.zfls.ppSuffixes.markdownDescripti: File extensions to run the preprocessor on (`--pp_suffixes`; default: upper-case extensions such as `.F90`).
config.zfls.arguments.markdownDescriptio: Extra command-line options for `zfls`, after those of the settings above; zfls accepts the same options as fortls (run `zfls --help`). Settings in a `.fortlsrc`, `.fortls.json` or `.fortls` file in the workspace also apply.
config.zfls.disableModernFortranCheck.ma: Do not recommend disabling the Modern Fortran extension, which zfls replaces, when both are enabled.
config.zfls.trace.server.markdownDescrip: Log the messages between VS Code and zfls in the `zfls` output channel.
config.zfls.run.compiler.markdownDescrip: The compiler that builds the file for **Run Fortran File** and **Debug Fortran File**, for example `gfortran`, `ifx`, `flang`, `nvfortran`, `nagfor` or `lfortran`; it is looked up on the `PATH` unless `#zfls.run.compilerPath#` is set.
config.zfls.run.compilerPath.markdownDes: The compiler executable, or the directory that holds `#zfls.run.compiler#`, when it is not on the `PATH`. `${workspaceFolder}`, `${env:NAME}`, `${userHome}` and a leading `~` are expanded.
config.zfls.run.buildArgs.markdownDescri: Compiler arguments, before the source file and the output file, which the extension adds. Not set (`null`): debug information without optimization, `-g -O0` (`/Zi /Od` for `ifx` and `ifort` on Windows, `-g` for `lfortran`). Variables are expanded as in `#zfls.run.compilerPath#`, and `${file}` and `${fileDirname}` too.
config.zfls.run.outputDirectory.markdown: Where the program and the compiler's module and object files go. Empty: a directory per source file in the extension's storage, so nothing is written next to the sources. A relative path is relative to the workspace folder.
config.zfls.run.cwd.markdownDescription: The working directory of the program; by default the directory of the file.
config.zfls.run.debugger.markdownDescrip: The debugger for **Debug Fortran File**. None is bundled: install one of the extensions it names.
config.zfls.run.debugger.enumDescription: The first installed of C/C++ (cppvsdbg for programs of ifx, ifort and LLVM Flang on Windows, else cppdbg), CodeLLDB and CDT GDB
C/C++ extension (ms-vscode.cpptools) with gdb, or lldb on macOS
C/C++ extension with the Visual Studio debugger (Windows, MSVC-ABI programs)
config.zfls.run.gdbPath.markdownDescript: The `gdb` for the `cppdbg` and `gdb` debuggers. Empty: the `gdb` next to the compiler, else the one on the `PATH`.
config.zfls.fpm.path.markdownDescription: The [fpm](https://fpm.fortran-lang.org) executable, or the directory that holds it. Empty: `fpm` on the `PATH`. Variables are expanded as in `#zfls.run.compilerPath#`.
config.zfls.fpm.profile.markdownDescript: `--profile` of fpm's builds, runs and tests: `debug`, `release`, or a feature profile of `fpm.toml`. Empty: fpm's default (`debug`). A task's `profile` takes precedence.
config.zfls.fpm.compiler.markdownDescrip: `--compiler` of fpm's builds, runs and tests, for example `ifx` or `flang`. Empty: fpm's default (`FPM_FC`, else `gfortran`). Debugging uses it to choose the debugger.
config.zfls.fpm.flags.markdownDescriptio: `--flag` of fpm's builds, runs and tests: the compiler flags, which replace the profile's.
config.zfls.fpm.args.markdownDescription: Extra arguments of fpm's builds, runs and tests, one per item, for example `["--features", "mpi"]`.
config.zfls.fpm.runFile.markdownDescript: **Run Fortran File** and **Debug Fortran File**, on the main program of a target of an fpm project, run or debug that target with fpm instead of building the file by itself. Its program arguments are `#zfls.run.programArgs#`.
config.zfls.fpm.testExplorer.markdownDes: Show the tests of fpm projects in the Testing view: each test target (`fpm test --list`), and the suites and tests of [test-drive](https://github.com/fortran-lang/test-drive) below it, with their results.
config.zfls.formatting.formatter.markdow: The external tool that formats Fortran files and selections (**Format Document**, **Format Selection**, format on save). It must be installed separately: `pip install findent` or `pip install fprettify`. Can be set per language, for example `"[FortranFixedForm]": { "zfls.formatting.formatter": "findent" }`.
config.zfls.formatting.formatter.enumDes: Indent with findent (free and fixed form)
config.zfls.formatting.path.markdownDesc: The formatter executable, or the directory that holds it, when it is not on the `PATH`. `${workspaceFolder}`, `${env:NAME}`, `${userHome}` and a leading `~` are expanded; a relative path is relative to the workspace folder.
config.zfls.formatting.findentArgs.markd: Extra arguments for `findent`, one per item, for example `["-i4"]`. The extension passes `-ifree` or `-ifixed` from the file's language unless these set the input format, and `-Ia` (keep the selection's indentation) when formatting a selection. Variables are expanded as in `#zfls.formatting.path#`.
config.zfls.formatting.fprettifyArgs.mar: Extra arguments for `fprettify`, one per item, for example `["--indent", "4", "--enable-decl"]`. fprettify also reads `.fprettify.rc` files from the file's directory and its parents. Variables are expanded as in `#zfls.formatting.path#`.
config.zfls.linter.runner.markdownDescri: Who runs `#zfls.linter.compiler#`: this extension, or the zfls language server. With `server`, `#zfls.linter.compilerPath#`, `#zfls.linter.extraArgs#` and `#zfls.linter.modOutput#` go to zfls; the other linter settings are the extension's.
config.zfls.linter.runner.enumDescriptio: This extension runs the compiler: with lint while typing, fypp, and glob patterns in the include paths

zfls runs the compiler, as it does for every editor (its compiler_diagnostics option): on opening and saving a file, after compiling the modules it uses. The include directories are zfls's (zfls.includeDirs); fypp files are still checked by the extension
config.zfls.linter.compiler.markdownDesc: Compiler that checks Fortran files when they are opened and saved; its errors and warnings show in the file and in the Problems panel. `Disabled` turns compiler diagnostics off. If the compiler is not found, zfls says so once and checks nothing.
config.zfls.linter.compilerPath.markdown: The compiler executable, or the directory that holds it. Empty: `zfls.linter.compiler` looked up on the `PATH`. Variables `${workspaceFolder}`, `${workspaceFolder:name}`, `${env:VAR}`, `${userHome}`, `${file}`, `${fileDirname}`, `${fileBasenameNoExtension}` and a leading `~` are resolved; a relative path is relative to the workspace folder.
config.zfls.linter.extraArgs.markdownDes: Further compiler options, such as `-std=f2018` or `-DDEBUG`. When empty, the compiler's usual warnings are on (`-Wall` for gfortran, `-warn all` for Intel, `-Minform=warn` for nvfortran); when set, these replace them. Variables `${workspaceFolder}`, `${workspaceFolder:name}`, `${env:VAR}`, `${userHome}`, `${file}`, `${fileDirname}`, `${fileBasenameNoExtension}` and a leading `~` are resolved.
config.zfls.linter.includePaths.markdown: Directories searched for `INCLUDE` files and `.mod` files (`-I`). Glob patterns such as `${workspaceFolder}/build/**/include` match directories. Variables `${workspaceFolder}`, `${workspaceFolder:name}`, `${env:VAR}`, `${userHome}`, `${file}`, `${fileDirname}`, `${fileBasenameNoExtension}` and a leading `~` are resolved; relative paths are relative to the workspace folder. Run **zfls: Clear Compiler Diagnostics** after creating directories that a pattern should match.
config.zfls.linter.modOutput.markdownDes: Directory for the `.mod` files the compiler writes while checking. Empty: a directory in VS Code's storage for this workspace, never the source tree. Variables `${workspaceFolder}`, `${workspaceFolder:name}`, `${env:VAR}`, `${userHome}`, `${file}`, `${fileDirname}`, `${fileBasenameNoExtension}` and a leading `~` are resolved.
config.zfls.linter.lintOnSave.markdownDe: Check a file when it is saved (files are always checked when opened).
config.zfls.linter.lintOnType.markdownDe: Check a file while it is edited, `#zfls.linter.lintOnTypeDelay#` milliseconds after the last change, compiling a copy of the unsaved text.
config.zfls.linter.lintOnTypeDelay.markd: Milliseconds without changes before `#zfls.linter.lintOnType#` checks a file.
config.zfls.linter.resolveModules.markdo: Before checking a file, compile the workspace files that define the modules it uses (and the modules those use), if their `.mod` files are missing or older than the files, so that `use` statements find them. Saving a module file checks the open files that use it again.
config.zfls.fortitude.enabled.markdownDe: Lint Fortran files with [fortitude](https://fortitude.readthedocs.io) when they are opened and saved, with its fixes as quick fixes and **zfls: Fix All Safe fortitude Problems** (also `source.fixAll.fortitude` in `#editor.codeActionsOnSave#`). It must be installed separately: `pip install fortitude-lint`. Its rules are set in `fpm.toml` or `fortitude.toml`.
config.zfls.fortitude.path.markdownDescr: The fortitude executable, or the directory that holds it. Empty: `fortitude` on the `PATH`. Variables are resolved as in `#zfls.linter.compilerPath#`.
config.zfls.fortitude.args.markdownDescr: Extra arguments for `fortitude check`, one per item, for example `["--select", "C,S"]` or `["--preview"]`.
config.zfls.fortitude.lintOnType.markdow: Also lint a file while it is edited, `#zfls.fortitude.lintOnTypeDelay#` milliseconds after the last change.
config.zfls.fortitude.lintOnTypeDelay.ma: Milliseconds without changes before `#zfls.fortitude.lintOnType#` lints a file.
config.zfls.codee.enabled.markdownDescri: Show the checks of [Codee](https://www.codee.com) (`codee checks --json`) when Fortran files are opened and saved, each linked to its page of Codee's Open Catalog. Codee is a commercial tool, installed and licensed separately; this support follows its documentation and is best-effort.
config.zfls.codee.path.markdownDescripti: The codee executable, or the directory that holds it. Empty: `codee` on the `PATH`.
config.zfls.codee.args.markdownDescripti: More arguments for `codee checks --json`, before the file: for example `["-p", "build/compile_commands.json"]`, or a compile command, `["${file}", "--", "gfortran", "-O2", "${file}"]` (where `${file}` is, the file is not added at the end).
config.zfls.linter.fypp.enabled.markdown: Run [fypp](https://fypp.readthedocs.io) on each file before compiling it. Without it, `.fypp` files are not checked.
config.zfls.linter.fypp.path.markdownDes: Path to the `fypp` executable. Variables `${workspaceFolder}`, `${workspaceFolder:name}`, `${env:VAR}`, `${userHome}`, `${file}`, `${fileDirname}`, `${fileBasenameNoExtension}` and a leading `~` are resolved.
config.zfls.linter.fypp.definitions.mark: Definitions passed to `fypp` as `-DNAME=VALUE` (`-DNAME` when the value is empty).
config.zfls.linter.fypp.includes.markdow: Include directories passed to `fypp` (`-I`); glob patterns and variables as in `#zfls.linter.includePaths#`.
config.zfls.linter.fypp.extraArgs.markdo: Further `fypp` options. zfls passes `--line-numbering --line-marker-format=cpp`, and `--fixed-format` for fixed-form files.

debugger.fortran.launch.program.descript: The program to debug (not needed with fpmTarget). A relative path is relative to the workspace folder.
debugger.fortran.launch.fpmTarget.descri: An fpm target to build with fpm and debug, from the fpm.toml of cwd or of the workspace folder.
debugger.fortran.launch.cwd.description: The working directory; by default the program's directory, or the fpm project's.
debugger.fortran.launch.env.description: More environment variables for the program.
debugger.fortran.launch.debugger.descrip: The debugger extension to run it with; auto: as zfls.run.debugger.
debugger.fortran.launch.compiler.descrip: The compiler that built the program (gfortran, ifx, flang, ...; default zfls.run.compiler, or for fpm targets zfls.fpm.compiler): on Windows it decides the debugger (MSVC ABI) and whose runtime libraries go on the PATH.
